regions.region: page 1 upper-right, Scheme 1 reaction drawing and caption
regions.finding: Hypothetical ring-opening/cyclization assumption from generic substrate 1 through M1 to proposed cyclohexene 2; classified as a general scheme, not a reported experiment.
Background and cited prior intramolecular cycloaddition/allene literature; not imported as experiments of this paper.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right initial trial and solvent-screen prose
regions.finding: Initial 1a/TMSCl/10 mol% FeCl3 trial in CH2Cl2 is merged with Table 1 entry 1 on page 2. Nine named non-CH2Cl2 solvent trials from cited Table S1 entries 2-10 are retained separately as qualitative failures; the SI table itself is unavailable.
The paper advertises Table S1, experimental details, analytical data, and spectra as ESI, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; no SI-only details were inferred.

unresolved: Table S1 and the remainder of the cited ESI are not supplied/associated, so solvent-row conditions and numeric outcomes beyond the main-text qualitative statement remain missing.
Generic and complex drawn structures have not been independently structure-verified; their SMILES remain null.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left, Table 1 scheme, rows 1-11, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Eleven Lewis-acid/control optimization rows were read individually. Table 1 entry 9 is merged with identical Table 2 entry 1. NMR yields and recovered 1a in rows 6, 8, 10, and 11 are kept distinct from isolated product yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right, Table 2 scheme, rows 1-14, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Fourteen substrate-scope rows were read row-by-row; rows 4, 7, and 8 use 6 mol% Zn(OTf)2 and row 14 uses TMSBr to give bromide 3n. The 4.7 mmol/83% footnote is a separate scale-up experiment.
The scale-up footnote visibly prints TMSCl as 5.64 mol for 4.7 mmol of 1a. This apparent source-unit error is preserved and flagged, not silently corrected.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left narrative below Tables 1 and 2
regions.finding: Narrative duplicates the standard/scale-up results. A source discrepancy for the 10 mol% Zn(OTf)2 result (81% in table/one sentence versus 84% in a later comparison) is retained in Table 1 entry 3.

regions.region: page 2 center-right, Scheme 2 hydrolysis arrow and ORTEP
regions.finding: Distinct hydrolysis of 3l with 2 M NaOH in EtOH at 60 °C for 1 h, followed by HCl quench, affords solid 4 in 94% isolated yield; X-ray/ORTEP is characterization, not another experiment.

A separate R2=H substrate control is reported as completely shut down, with most operational details unstated. The remaining prose proposes the A-E mechanism shown on page 3 and is classified as mechanism, not experiment.

unresolved: Most table rows omit workup and purification; the R2=H control also omits exact substrate identity and all operational conditions.
The source disagreement 81% versus 84% for 10 mol% Zn(OTf)2 remains unresolved.
The scale-up footnote's printed 5.64 mol TMSCl is chemically inconsistent with 4.7 mmol substrate and is retained as printed pending source review.
No SI was supplied, so product analytical data and detailed procedures were not imported.

regions.finding: Plausible Lewis-acid-promoted ring-opening/cyclization mechanism through generic intermediates A-E; classified as mechanism and not assigned an experimental yield.

regions.region: page 3 left column below Scheme 3, conclusion and acknowledgements
regions.finding: No new reaction arrow. The acknowledgement says preparations for Table 2 entries 5, 10, and 13 were reproduced; this is linked to those existing rows without creating duplicates.

References are prior literature and not experiments of this paper. Note 14 characterizes compound 4 crystallographically and is linked to the Scheme 2 hydrolysis record, not counted as a new reaction.

unresolved: Generic mechanistic structures and intermediates A-E do not define unique machine-verifiable SMILES.
No SI or CIF was supplied/associated; only the printed main-text crystal note is available.
